## TextReveal.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `text` :: The text that is revealed. It is also the accessible name of the wrapper.
- `by` :: How the text is split into staggered pieces.
- `preset` :: The entrance each piece uses.
- `step` :: Delay between one piece and the next, in milliseconds. Written to the `--stagger` channel.
- `trigger` :: `mount` plays as soon as the element is created; `inView` waits until it enters the viewport.
- `as` :: The element tag to render as.
